items.title: The Rise of the Wellness Revolution
items.summary: Employee wellness, especially financial well-being, is essential for a productive and healthy workplace. The Covid-19 pandemic has exacerbated financial struggles, increasing stress and anxiety among employees. At Floatpays, we believe in a comprehensive approach to wellness, providing tools that empower employees to break free from debt cycles and build financial stability. Our interview with Kyle Chetty of Planet42 highlights the need for a holistic wellness strategy, encompassing physical, psycho-social, organisational, and work-life balance. By promoting financial literacy and offering automated savings programs, businesses can create a supportive environment for their employees' financial health.
